name: context-forge
description: Session hygiene for long builds. HANDOFF compacts the current session into a dated handoff brief (goal, decisions with reasons, invariants, touched-file map, current state, next steps, open questions) saved to .zcode/handoffs/ so a fresh session resumes without quality loss. CONVENTIONS derives project rules from the actual codebase and merges them into AGENTS.md, each rule marked with its file:line evidence. REFRESH updates an existing handoff after more work. Briefs are facts extracted from the session and code, never invented; every claim carries a pointer.
